UPGRADE GUIDE

Check before buying a component

Confirm the configuration, mounting hardware and exact part details.

Confirm the current configuration

Record the model and four-character machine type. For RAM, verify soldered capacity, installed modules and available sockets. For storage, verify the current drive’s dimensions, interface and mounting hardware. Confirm the manufacturer’s instructions for accessing your exact unit.

Check the part listing

Match the component specification against both the laptop documentation and the part datasheet. Check for exclusions such as a shared WWAN position or a main bay that accepts only one drive arrangement. If a detail is unclear, confirm it before ordering.
